title: 36 Hours in Milwaukee
abstract: Beyond the beer and bratwurst, this city has 95 miles of bike lanes, lush parks lacing the shores of Lake Michigan and a revitalized riverfront.

title: 36 Hours in New York City
abstract: Explore decadent burger joints, comfy-slick Brooklyn bars and hotel rooftops with a Chinese theme.

title: 36 Hours: New York City
abstract: From new restaurants featuring ever-more inventive menus to hipster hangouts colonizing yet another part of Brooklyn, a shaky economy is no reason to sit home.

title: 36 Hours in Paris
abstract: From West African restaurateurs to Eastern European bakers, the city’s most lively district, the Marais, brims with a vivid mix of characters.

title: 36 Hours in Charlottesville, Va.
abstract: Though it’s known for its neo-Classical architecture, this Southern town’s innovative culinary and music scene would make Thomas Jefferson proud.
